'''House Nidantha''' was one of the [[Tapani Noble Houses|noble houses]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] prior to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Thought to have collapsed on itself by the other Houses, remnants of House Nidantha had in fact survived in the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and later in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].

==History==
Following the [[Unification War]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] that resulted in the unification of the [[Tapani Noble Houses]] and the supremacy of [[House Melantha]], House Nidantha left the sector in order to find a new destiny. During their exodus, its members reached the [[Stygian Caldera]] where they were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]].

By the time of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], some of their [[Human/Legends|Human]] descendants had rose to position of power within the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] fleets, such as [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Eldrak Korsin]]. With millennia of interbreeding with their [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] masters, an increased number of them also became [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] while retaining their human features and learned the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].

In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the ''[[Omen]]'', a ship of the Sith Empire crash-landed on the remote [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], where the humans shipwrecked founded the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], a new civilization mixing aspects of the Sith, Tapani and [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] cultures.
